_note: INTERNAL. Fire test reports held on file, encoded so the matching engine can reason over them. One record per report. Never rendered with sponsor names customer-side — the report reference numbers themselves are lab identifiers and safe to cite on a sheet. Both reports below are the same construction tested in opposite directions two days apart; together they are the basis of the supplier's 'bi-directionally tested' claim. Neither report states an E/EW/EI classification under EN 13501-2 and insulation was not evaluated in either — any EW claim rests on supplier literature/certification, not on these reports.

reports._direction: Leaves opened AWAY from the furnace (EN 1634-1 Table 2). Covers fire risk on the hinge/room side.
reports.radiationNote: Single leaf peaked at 4.96 kW/m² (never crossed the 5 kW/m² threshold); double leaf crossed 5 kW/m² at 58:30. No EN 13501-2 classification is provided by the report.

reports._direction: Leaves opened TOWARDS the furnace. Covers fire risk on the opening/shaft side. The single leaf took a 6 mm gap-gauge failure at 118 minutes — this is what limits single-leaf bi-directional cover to 90 minutes.
reports.radiationNote: Double leaf peaked at 3.76 kW/m²; single leaf crossed 5 kW/m² at 78:30. No EN 13501-2 classification is provided by the report.
